tolerance_v2_rule: Subject divisor from the lever arm = lever implied mass on the re-run trial / ankle_bias centre; a candidate mass is consistent when |log(divisor / candidate)| <= ankle_bias half width (max(3 robust sd, log 1.05)). Exact re-run divisors (every ankle/knee column correlation >= 0.9999) override the lever arm. A trial is flagged when its lever implied mass deviates from the same subject's re-run-trial lever implied mass by more than the trial half width (max(3 robust sd, log 1.10)).
